desc: decode the information found in the Sony Vaio laptop identification EEPROMs
r: decode-vaio - decode the information found in the Sony Vaio laptop identification EEPROMs
The purpose of the decode-vaio tool is to decode the information found in the Sony Vaio laptop identification EEPROMs. The tool requires the eeprom kernel module to be loaded.
To report bugs or send fixes, please write to the Linux I2C mailing list <linux-i2c@vger.kernel.org> with Cc to the current maintainer: Jean Delvare <jdelvare@suse.de>.
